description: Convert pixel values (px) to CSS rem and em units instantly. Set custom root base font size and copy responsive CSS code.
faq_items: What is the standard base font size?:::The default browser base font size is 16px (1rem = 16px). You can customize this in the tool.|||Why use REM instead of PX in CSS?:::REM units scale with the user's browser accessibility font settings, making websites more accessible and responsive.|||Can I convert REM back to PX?:::Yes, the tool converts bidirectionally between px and rem in real time.

faq_items: Do these QR codes expire?:::No, standard static QR codes encode your data directly into the pattern and never expire.|||Can I download the generated QR code?:::Yes, click the Download Image button to save the QR code as a PNG image.|||Is there a limit on QR code creation?:::No, you can generate unlimited QR codes for personal and commercial use for free.

description: Compress and minify CSS code by stripping whitespace, comments, and redundant formatting. Boost website speed and improve Google PageSpeed performance.
faq_items: What does CSS minification do?:::CSS minification removes unnecessary characters, whitespace, and comments without altering how stylesheets render in the browser.|||How much file size can I save?:::Minification typically reduces stylesheet file size by 20% to 50%, speeding up page load times.|||Is this CSS minifier safe for production?:::Yes, it preserves all valid CSS rules, selectors, and properties while compressing layout whitespace.

description: Minify HTML documents and component templates. Remove comments, whitespace, and line breaks to optimize DOM load speed and bandwidth usage.
faq_items: Why should I minify HTML?:::Minifying HTML reduces transfer size over the network, leading to faster First Contentful Paint (FCP) and better Core Web Vitals scores.|||Will minification break my HTML layout?:::No, standard whitespace between tags is safely handled while eliminating excessive line breaks and comments.|||Is my code processed privately?:::Yes, minification runs entirely inside your client browser with no external server requests.

description: Format and beautify messy SQL queries with proper keyword indentation, uppercase keywords, and clean line breaks.
faq_items: Which SQL dialects are supported?:::Formats standard ANSI SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and BigQuery syntax.|||Does it capitalize keywords automatically?:::Yes, SELECT, FROM, WHERE, JOIN and all standard keywords are formatted to uppercase.|||Is my database query private?:::Yes, formatting runs 100% in your browser with no database connection required.

description: Test regular expressions in real-time with instant match highlighting, capture group breakdown, and standard regex cheat sheet.
